recharge.title: Recharge
recharge.payment_warning: Otherwise the system cannot match your order!
recharge.notice_1: Please use the correct address and currency for recharge, otherwise it cannot be recovered. If you need to recharge other currencies, please close this page, reselect and then go to the recharge page. Please make sure the currency you recharge matches the currency on the recharge page, otherwise the assets cannot be recovered. Deposits to the above address will be credited after network confirmation, some blockchain networks may have delays, please wait patiently. Minimum recharge amount is 19USD, if it is lower than this amount, the recharge will not be automatically processed by the system.
recharge.notice_2: If you choose a network that does not correspond to the currency for recharge, for example, you selected TRC20 network but used the wrong network for recharge, the system will not receive the currency. In this case, the funds will be returned to the original payment address. If you encounter this situation, please don't worry and wait patiently. It will usually be automatically returned within 10 minutes to 1 hour.
recharge.notice_3: Please be sure to check the amount above when making payment, if you transfer the wrong amount, it will lead to matching failure and the system will not automatically credit the account.
recharge.notice_4: Please do not recharge currencies or amounts other than those specified in the order to the above address, otherwise the assets cannot be recovered and credited.
recharge.cancel_tip: Are you sure you want to cancel the current order?
recharge.payment_success_tip: Your recharge has been submitted, please wait patiently for it to be credited
recharge.payment_confirm_message: If the recharge is successful within 10 minutes, the system will automatically match. If you have any questions, please contact customer service. Note: We are not responsible for losses caused by mismatches between order amount and payment amount due to your operational errors.
